meta.title: lpdf Showcase — Markdown tables
meta.subject: The lines and the stripe of a Markdown table, on and off

markdown.markdown-content:
# A table as Markdown has it
The default: a line under the header and a fainter line under each row, with no stripe.
| Plan | Seats | Price | |:-----|------:|------:| | Starter | 5 | $29 | | Team | 25 | $99 | | Business | 100 | $299 | | Scale | 500 | $999 |
The text after the table.

# Striped, with no lines
The stripe is on and both lines are off: `stripe="surface-alt" head-border="none" row-border="none"`.
| Plan | Seats | Price | |:-----|------:|------:| | Starter | 5 | $29 | | Team | 25 | $99 | | Business | 100 | $299 | | Scale | 500 | $999 |
The text after the table.

# Striped, with lines
The stripe is on and the lines stay: `stripe="surface-alt"`.
| Plan | Seats | Price | |:-----|------:|------:| | Starter | 5 | $29 | | Team | 25 | $99 | | Business | 100 | $299 | | Scale | 500 | $999 |
The text after the table.

# No stripe, no lines
Both lines are off: `head-border="none" row-border="none"`.
| Plan | Seats | Price | |:-----|------:|------:| | Starter | 5 | $29 | | Team | 25 | $99 | | Business | 100 | $299 | | Scale | 500 | $999 |
The text after the table.
